description: Take a film out of the working folder. It needs confirm: true, and the user's word first. The file is moved to the folder's .trash/ with its earlier versions, not erased: the answer says where, and restore_film brings it back. Exported files stay.

confirm.description: Must be true: say so only once the user agreed

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

name: delete_film
title: Delete a film
